---
title: "Applications"
sidebarTitle: "Overview"
description: "List, create, read, update and delete the OAuth applications registered on your Exsited instance."
---

Applications are the OAuth applications registered on your Exsited instance. You can list, create, read, update and delete them. This area has 5 endpoints, and all seven SDKs call every one.

<Warning>
  **The client id and secret of a new application are generated by Exsited and never returned by the API.**
</Warning>

## At a glance

| Endpoint | Method | Path | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [List applications](/api-reference/applications/list-applications) | <span style={{fontFamily: "var(--font-mono, monospace)", fontSize: "0.72rem", fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: "0.02em", color: "#0f7b6c"}}>GET</span> | `…/applications` | Returns one page of the OAuth applications on your instance. |
| [Create an application](/api-reference/applications/create-an-application) | <span style={{fontFamily: "var(--font-mono, monospace)", fontSize: "0.72rem", fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: "0.02em", color: "#2563eb"}}>POST</span> | `…/applications` | Creates an OAuth application and returns it under `application`. |
| [Retrieve an application](/api-reference/applications/retrieve-an-application) | <span style={{fontFamily: "var(--font-mono, monospace)", fontSize: "0.72rem", fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: "0.02em", color: "#0f7b6c"}}>GET</span> | `…/applications/{application_id}` | Returns one OAuth application by its `app_` id. |
| [Delete an application](/api-reference/applications/delete-an-application) | <span style={{fontFamily: "var(--font-mono, monospace)", fontSize: "0.72rem", fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: "0.02em", color: "#c2410c"}}>DELETE</span> | `…/applications/{application_id}` | Deletes an OAuth application and returns no body. |
| [Update an application](/api-reference/applications/update-an-application) | <span style={{fontFamily: "var(--font-mono, monospace)", fontSize: "0.72rem", fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: "0.02em", color: "#7a5af8"}}>PATCH</span> | `…/applications/{application_id}` | Changes an OAuth application's fields or its status and returns it under `application`. |

## Before you call

Register your API credentials once when your app starts, as shown in
[Authentication](/authentication). Every SDK sample on these pages then gets its client in one line.
With cURL, send the access token in an `Authorization` header: `Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS_TOKEN`.

## Things to know

- **`name` and `redirect_url` are required to create an application.** Send them under `application`.
- **Applications are identified by an `app_` id.** Use the `id` from a create or a listing as `application_id`.
- **Every single record comes back under `application`.** Create, read and update all return `{"application": {...}}`.
- **Delete returns `204` with no body.** A read of the deleted application then returns `404`.
- **The listing pages by cursor.** Records are under `data`, with `limit`, `has_more` and `next_cursor` in `pagination`.
